settings.heading:
You have bought him
beds before.
settings.lede: Good ones. He still gets up in the night.
settings.body:
It was never the shape, the colour or the brand. It is that fibre filling does not stay where you put it. Under a dog's weight it migrates to the edges and packs down in the middle – exactly where his hips and shoulders go.

A solid memory foam core cannot migrate. It is one continuous piece, cut to size.

settings.heading: Where the padding goes.
settings.standfirst: Fibre filling does not wear out. It moves – to the edges, away from the weight – and it takes about a month.
settings.punchline: By the end he is sleeping on your floorboards with a cover over them. So he shifts – not because he is restless, but because there is nowhere on that bed that stays comfortable for more than an hour.

settings.title: 15cm of loft, evenly spread
settings.text: It arrives full. The filling sits where the photograph showed it, and for the first fortnight it behaves.
settings.alt: Cross-section of a new bed: an even slab of filling at full height

settings.title: The filling starts to move
settings.text: Fibre does not compress evenly, it migrates. It travels to the edges and packs down under the four points carrying his weight: hips, shoulders and both elbows.
settings.alt: Cross-section after three weeks: the slab is lower and its middle has begun to dip

settings.title: A folded tea towel
settings.measure: Roughly the thickness of a tea towel
settings.text: What arrived as 15cm of padding is now a couple of centimetres in the middle, with a ridge of displaced filling around the rim he cannot lie on.
settings.alt: Cross-section after two months: the slab is thin and its middle has collapsed almost to the floor

settings.eyebrow: Why it costs what it costs
settings.heading: Density isn't firmness. It's how much foam is actually in the foam.
settings.body:
Most dog beds are filled with shredded offcuts or low-density foam. They feel wonderful in the shop, and they bottom out inside a year – at which point your dog is sleeping on the floor with a cover over it.

Every PawLunova memory foam core is 50kg/m³. That number is what decides whether a bed is still doing its job in year five. It's also why we're willing to guarantee the foam for five of them.
settings.density_caption: High-density memory foam core, CertiPUR-US certified and free from harmful chemicals.
